projects.name: TrueLane Studio: Apex Architect
projects.description: Vehicle-independent engineering and tuning research software for comparing simulated configurations and reviewing supporting evidence.
projects.currentState: v1.8 software development broadens vehicle and powertrain coverage and configuration search. The reference is simulation-only and does not apply changes to a physical vehicle. Independent real-world performance remains to be qualified.
projects.buyers: Automotive engineering teams, simulation providers and specialist R&D groups
projects.applications: Engineering scenario comparison, model review and evidence-led tuning research
projects.qualification: Which vehicle-specific measurements and independent validation support the intended use, and which rights are distinct from related TrueLane assets?

projects.name: SWPP / VIORITH Mobile Camera Overlay
projects.description: Phone-first spatial-perception software foundation for presenting camera-based object information through a mobile overlay.
projects.currentState: v0.1 provides an early mobile camera-overlay foundation with repository-reported internal software checks. Native phone integration and physical-device qualification remain to be established.
projects.buyers: Mobile application teams, spatial-computing developers and product R&D groups
projects.applications: Phone-based visual-assistance concepts and exploratory camera-overlay experiences
projects.qualification: Which native device integration, measured latency, calibration and independent device evidence support the proposed experience?
